external_sources.locator: Singapore Ministry of Education, 2021 Lower Secondary History Teaching and Learning Syllabus, Table 1.1, printed p. 5: “Chronology” and “Cause and Effect (Causation).”

material.locator: AHA, “Introduction to Doing World History”: “Big Picture” method, using timelines of important events and an accompanying explanation of their significance.
material.description: The AHA “Big Picture” method supports chronological organization of events but does not by itself prove causal relationships. The supplementary Singapore MOE syllabus distinguishes chronological order from causal explanation; it is an educational framework from Singapore, not a universal standard or proof of any particular historical cause.
